comment: TRADER BEE = bounded partial automation. It may BUY on its own, but ONLY from its own dedicated wallet, ONLY at the fixed sizes below, ONLY on research-verified contracts on Base / Robinhood Chain, ONLY inside the budgets below, and ONLY after every hard gate passes. Sells, take-profits and anything a soft gate flags wait for the beekeeper's approval. Every number here is a BEEKEEPER SETTING: change it deliberately; the agent never changes it.
mode_comment: paper = simulate with live quotes, spend nothing. live = real swaps, and ALSO requires the arm file written by `python trader.py arm` (a human act). live without arming behaves as paper.

discovery_tier.comment: One buy per asset, ever, sized by research confidence: high $10, medium $5, low $1.

zone_entry.comment: $1 when a gate-PASS, BUY/WATCH-ranked asset ENTERS the NUK3R2 buy zone (Fib Bee fib.zone.entered). One buy per structure; a re-anchored structure can trigger again after the cooldown.

confidence_bands.comment: Used ONLY when a verdict carries no explicit `confidence` (the Research Bee always sets it). Mirrors the beekeeper's Opportunity Matrix: Exceptional candidate (Core 45+ / Timing 17+) = high ($10) · Priority Opportunity (40+ / 13+) = medium ($5) · every other class = low ($1).

budget.comment: Rolling windows (last 24h / last 7d) of stable actually committed. The wallet balance is the final cap: fund it with only what you are willing to let it spend.

gates.comment: Hard gates reject. Soft gates ('approval') park the buy in the approval queue for the beekeeper. unexplained_clone = a same-ticker token on the same chain with MORE liquidity that research did not list as a known decoy. min_security_score 75 is an OPERATOR SETTING, not a sourced constant.

execution.allowed_spenders_comment: Pinned routers. If an aggregator returns any other spender/router the executor REFUSES and logs the exact address. Base: 1inch AggregationRouterV6 (0x1111…2A65, also the 1inch limit-order protocol) and KyberSwap MetaAggregationRouterV2 (0x6131…37b5). Robinhood Chain: 1inch deployed at a DIFFERENT address there — 0x5a70…89c7 is the limit-order protocol per 1inch's official @1inch/limit-order-sdk constants, and is expected to be the swap router too. Before arming on Robinhood, confirm each address on the chain's explorer; remove any you cannot confirm.

take_profit.comment: After a fill the Bee PROPOSES a resting 1inch limit sell at the NSZ edge (21.4% level of the body-high structure) for half the position. Proposals only — nothing is placed until you approve it.

safety.arm_phrase: I FUNDED THIS WALLET AND ARM THE TRADER BEE
